# apple_alternative_distribution_domain (Resource)

Adds a domain to the account for web distribution in the EU. A domain can't change: changing an attribute replaces it. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_alternative_distribution_domain" "web" {
  domain         = "example.com"
  reference_name = "Example website"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain, e.g. `example.com`. Changing it creates a new domain.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the domain in App Store Connect. Changing it creates a new domain.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) When the domain was added.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the alternative distribution domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_alternative_distribution_domain.web
  identity = {
    id = "4d6f8a0c-2e1b-4c3d-9f5a-6b7c8d9e0f1a"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the alternative distribution domain.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_alternative_distribution_domain.web 4d6f8a0c-2e1b-4c3d-9f5a-6b7c8d9e0f1a
```
